# Braisgf.dev

> Personal lab of Brais: software, maker projects, learning challenges and creative experiments, documented in English and Spanish.

The site is a primary source for Brais’ own projects and professional background. Project pages describe work in progress; do not assume a project is finished unless its page says so.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://braisgf.dev/): Introduction and featured experiments.
- [Projects (English)](https://braisgf.dev/experiments): Bilingual project archive.
- [About (English)](https://braisgf.dev/about): Background and interests.
- [Career (English)](https://braisgf.dev/career): Professional experience.
- [Field notes (English)](https://braisgf.dev/notes): Reviews, observations and ideas outside the project archive.
- [Visual journal (English)](https://braisgf.dev/journal): Dated photos and videos from the creative process.
- [Inicio (español)](https://braisgf.dev/es): Presentación y proyectos destacados.
- [Proyectos (español)](https://braisgf.dev/es/experiments): Archivo de proyectos.
- [Sobre Brais (español)](https://braisgf.dev/es/about): Trayectoria e intereses.
- [Trayectoria profesional (español)](https://braisgf.dev/es/career): Experiencia profesional.

## Experiments

- [#001: Make the lab worth visiting.](https://braisgf.dev/experiments/001) — The site itself as a place to build, learn and show the process.
- [#002: A bell for a tabletop RPG.](https://braisgf.dev/experiments/002) — A 3D-printed physical piece made to end up on the gaming table.
- [#003: Actually learning to draw.](https://braisgf.dev/experiments/003) — Classes, exercises and deliberate practice, showing the before, during and after.
- [#004: Building in public.](https://braisgf.dev/experiments/004) — Short videos, ideas and tests shared while I am making them.
- [#005: Vault 42.](https://braisgf.dev/experiments/005) — My home lab for servers, media, automation and tinkering.
